method.excluded_warmup_count: All present iteration-zero cells, including any failed warmup; successful_excluded_warmup and failed_warmup are separate.
method.retained_command_failure_marker: The exact observed-BA command-exit-1 marker remains invalid and hashed. Response-valid cells are descriptive only; the overall attempt is not reclassified as successful.
method.failed_metrics: Null; partial diagnostic counters are not throughput or latency evidence.
method.missing_cells: Expected cells absent from raw artifacts remain explicit with null raw hashes; no observations are imputed.
method.pooled: All accepted samples; metric n, median, minimum and maximum remain explicit.
method.role_balanced: Median of both orientation medians only when both are available; per-role n and medians remain explicit. Unequal n is not imputed.
method.percentiles: Distributions summarize per-sample percentile values, not a pooled request histogram.
method.comparisons: Ratios are descriptive only. Coverage is explicit; no winner or favorable-direction decision is made.
method.cold: Fresh server process; first full response, not TTFB. Long-lived client warmed by iteration 0; 32 first-connection requests, then 1 second-connection request. Iteration 0 is excluded. OS/file caches are not controlled cold.
method.raw_jsonl_record_digest: SHA256 of the UTF-8 JSON line without line terminator; exact file hash also retained.

configuration.gc: Server GC, concurrent; identical runtime configuration for all engines

host_activity.limitation: All available raw windows include warmups and failed cells. A short failed window does not certify the requested duration or missing intervals; these counters do not establish absence of competing work. Separate observation is required.
